spec.aggregation: Sum correct and accepted pairs / sum counts within each parent,time cell; six states (three K, two noises). No state-wise averaging.
spec.gap: Unweighted Euclidean distances of both aligned endpoints of each selected pair; model coordinate units, L_ref=1. No GT bbox normalization.
spec.coverage: Fixed C/C pairs excluded. Category coverage uses that category in the same full dynamic matching as denominator.
spec.GT_scope: Independent source identity and endpoint correspondence scoring only; never supplied to matcher or model.

calibration.gradients: CPU FP32 velocity leaves, not network parameters; original saved Yhat values and endpoint Jacobian

timing.accounting_note: Matching/structural-risk components are nested within CPU diagnosis wall time. Forward/load/rollout timings are nested within capture wall time; do not add both levels.

limitations: 48 teacher states are 12 fixed noise/target pairs each at 4 times, not 48 independent objects.
Teacher Yhat confidence rejects no pairs in this bank; it does not yet demonstrate confidence increment.
The window is a preregistered pilot filter on the common initialization; no guarantee for evolving weights or free generation.
Four diagnostic trajectories use one shared seed10300 and two parents/patch0,2; they are mechanisms, not formal endpoint outcome means.
GT partner precision is NOT_AVAILABLE on free trajectories; stable or confident pair identities do not prove correctness.
Full-matching structural risks are not a legal-closure rate; no final CF/FF or orientability postprocessing audit is performed by this summary.
No new matches, geometry distances, model calls, gradients or training updates were executed to create this summary.
